outcome: Coded failures reach the operator by name: stable error-code resolution unwraps journal and baton record errors, and the baton-action completion path stops flattening to baton_action_failed, so a STALE_RETRY_EPOCH or TARGET_DIVERGED surfaces as itself in sworn status instead of drowning in operational_failure.

exclude: the board diagnostic rendering path (baton.Diagnostic flattening in cockpit and tui is a distinct defect and a separate slice candidate)
renaming any error code, or removing operational_failure as the terminal default for genuinely uncoded errors

acceptance.text: A journal error carrying STALE_RETRY_EPOCH that fails an effect surfaces error_code STALE_RETRY_EPOCH in the journaled completion and through the status surface: pinned by a unit fixture beside the existing stable-code pins in internal/runtime and a status read-back fixture.
A failed baton action journals its record-error code, TARGET_DIVERGED for the diverged case, not baton_action_failed: pinned by a runtime completion fixture reading the journaled effects error code.
The CLI resolves the same codes: cmd/sworn's command error-code resolution covers baton record errors with parity to the runtime resolution, pinned by a cmd/sworn unit fixture.

Existing precedence pins pass unmodified - TestStableErrorCodeCarriesUncontainedDispatchRefusal and TestStableErrorCodePreservesTrackBaseAuthorityMovement in internal/runtime - and the e2e topology expectation that today tolerates operational_failure names the real code, declared (ADR 0010), not executed.

constraints: operational_failure remains the terminal fallback for genuinely uncoded errors; no code is renamed and no recorded journal is reinterpreted.
Unwrapping preserves existing precedence: runtime, gitx and contract errors keep winning exactly where they win today.

Evidence basis: STALE_RETRY_EPOCH surfacing as bare operational_failure cost most of the sworn#216 diagnosis and required a diagnostic rebuild; the first real model run showed operational_failure for every failure mode (docs/captures/2026-08-09-first-real-model-run).
The e2e check is declared, not executed by a role (ADR 0010).
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository.
